headline: Sensex and Nifty decline sharply as IT stocks drag and profit booking weighs on sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Heavy sell-off in IT stocks dragged down benchmark indices.
Investors engaged in profit booking after a brief market rally.
Concerns over crude oil price spikes heightened RBI rate hike expectations.
India's forex reserves dropped by $4.44 billion due to losses in gold assets.
whatHappening: Sensex crashed over 700 to nearly 989 points during the trading session.
Nifty 50 slipped below key levels of 25,700 and 25,650.
Metal stocks outperformed the broader market despite IT sector pressure.
RBI lowered bank CRR maintenance requirement back to 90% starting December 1.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty traded significantly lower on November 27, 2026, driven by a broad sell-off in IT stocks and profit booking. India's forex reserves fell to $700.90 billion while oil price spikes added to bond market pressures. In corporate developments, TVS Motor entered the cargo tricycle market and BPCL commissioned a new lube blending plant in Maharashtra.
